newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil private coffee sector prepares for council.
newsitem.headline: Brazil private coffee sector prepares for council.

text.p: Private sector members of a new council which is to decide future Brazilian coffee policy met for over eight hours today in Sao Paulo in preparation for the council's official installation on January 17, a producer official said.

However the official declined to give details of the talks prior to the ceremony marking the creation of the Conselho Deliberativo da Politica Cafeeira, or the CDPC as it is known, to be held in Brasilia.
The council is to be comprised of 12 members - six each from the public and private sectors - as well as its president, Industry and Commerce Minister Francisco Dornelles.
Yesterday the head of the primary commodities department of the Industry and Commerce Ministry said there would be no actual meeting of the CDPC on January 17, only an official ceremony.
However the producer official said that private sector representatives would still ask to have a full meeting on Friday.
(-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151)
